text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I told you it was a fearsome opponent, despite the cuteness of the plushies.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No! I know this situation all too well. Trust me, the road you're trying to go down is a one-way ticket to rock bottom!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All that happens is your money flies off and your roommate gets angry… It's not good at all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But! The day will come when you can don your mask again. Believe in that day and exit the ring for now.
